portals.name: Clark County Assessor/GISMO AssessorMap FeatureServer layer 1
portals.operator: Clark County Assessor and GIS Management Office (GISMO)
portals.observation: Official polygon parcel layer queried anonymously with outFields limited to OID and APN. Adapter returned 78 unique parcels across 11 of 13 0.001-degree viewport cells around the WUP centroid; two cells returned HTTP 500. Forced pageSize=3 returned 20/20 geometries across seven pages with exact hashes. Fresh exact-ID retrieval covered all 78 records, and a deliberately absent APN was reported absent. Selected parcel footprint and source binding passed. These are bounded viewport observations, not total city/county counts.

requests.observation: Initial bounded query near exact WUP point returned three complete Polygon features; only OID/APN requested. IDs: 16204399004, 16204699026, 16204701002.

Runner exercised 13 viewport cells; 11 passed, returning 78 unique complete polygons; cells viewport-3 and viewport-11 failed with HTTP 500. 11 successful cells were complete and geometries stayed within their query envelopes.

Forced three-row pagination passed (20 features, 7 geometry pages, hashes stable); fresh exact-ID requests passed for all 78; explicit absent identifier US-NV-CLARK-999999999999999 returned absent; footprint query and source-binding passed. Run details in las-vegas-acceptance.json.
